description: List the workspace media library, newest first, to reuse an existing image, video or document instead of uploading it again. Filter with type (image, video, document, audio) and q (text in the file name, display name or description); page with limit and cursor. To attach an item, pass its id as content.media[].media_id (or the bare UUID) in aidelly_create_post or aidelly_create_scheduled_post; the whole item is not a valid media entry. Download files with signed_url (expires after one hour); read_url needs an Aidelly session.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_list_media
title: List Media
